\item \textit{Notes:} Intraday models of the final design, rolling window of \rhfipWindowDays{} trading days, full predictor set (\rhfipNCols{} predictors in \rhfipNGroups{} groups: \rhfipNExog{} exogenous series, the HAR components, the calendar dummies), re-estimated at \rhfipNOrigins{} monthly origins (\rhfipFirstOrigin{} to \rhfipLastOrigin); the \rhfipNRows{} explained bars include the \rhfipNHolBars{} bars of \rhfipNHolSessions{} shortened futures sessions on NYSE holidays, which Table~\ref{tab:rh_oos} does not score (it scores \rhorNIntB{} bars); together the origins' models forecast all \rhfipNRows{} bars from \rhfipFirstOrigin{} to \rhfipLastDay. Tree ensembles: the share $s_A$ of group $A$ in the total mean absolute TreeSHAP value over all bars, $\phi_A$ summed over the group's predictors, with \rhfipCiLevel\% moving-block bootstrap intervals over the origins (blocks of \rhfipBootBlock{} origins, \rhfipBootB{} resamples) in brackets. Linear models: the share of the absolute coefficients on the window-standardized predictors, $|\gamma_{k,j}| = |\hat\beta_{k,j}|\,\mathrm{sd}_{k,j}$, summed over the origins (penalties: ridge \rhfipRidgePen, lasso \rhfipLassoPen, elastic net \rhfipEnetPen); the HAR components carry the penalty factor \rhfipHarPf, so their linear shares and the linear ``of the total'' rows are not comparable with the trees'. The two measures differ, so the table compares shares of each model's own measure. Standard: the HAR components, the calendar dummies, the \rhfipNMom{} futures realized moments, the VIX, the futures volume and trade count (\rhfipNStd{} groups); non-standard: the other \rhfipNNonStd{} series. $D$: paired bootstrap interval. Panel D, computed here from the pooled shares (descriptive): $N_{\mathrm{eff}}$, the effective number of series, and the fewest series whose shares sum to half and to 80\% of the exogenous total; Spearman rank correlation of the \rhfipNExog{} shares with the linear model's, and in parentheses the overlap of the two top-10 lists.
